input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 (Limitation of Liability) contains only a mutual exclusion of consequential/indirect damages (with indemnification and confidentiality carved out of that exclusion). Nothing in Section 7, the warranty section (Section 9), the indemnity sections (Sections 10-11) or the general provisions imposes any aggregate liability cap, so both parties' direct liability is unlimited and the fallback element "cap based on 12 months of fees" fails outright. We therefore add a single mutual cap sentence. Because the commercial structure is a revenue share (Section 5) under which Customer pays no material fees, a bare 12-months'-fees cap would be illusory; we target the preferred position so the USD 1,000,000 floor applies, and keep indemnification, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP outside the cap, with Customer's payment obligations not treated as capped damages. The existing mutual consequential-damages exclusion already satisfies that preferred element and is left untouched.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.

proposal.summary: Add mutual aggregate liability cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped Excluded Claims and Customer payment obligations outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes consequential damages but sets no aggregate cap, so each party's direct liability is unlimited. We add a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 (the floor matters because this is a revenue-share arrangement), and keep indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP outside the cap, with Customer's payment obligations not treated as capped damages.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (ii) USD 1,000,000. Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement shall not be considered damages subject to this cap. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights.
